hooks.command: cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command'); if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE '\b(cat|grep|egrep|fgrep|zcat|sed|head|tail|less|more|awk|xxd|od|strings|nl|tac|cut|bat|dd|vi|vim|view|nano)\b[^|;&]*\.env(\.[A-Za-z0-9_]+)?\b'; then printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Reading .env file contents is blocked by project policy (.claude/settings.json)."}}'; fi
